data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2021 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were $1,721.8m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates an overall adverse prior year development (gross strengthening) of $47.1m (approx. 2.7% of opening gross claims), driven by increases in several older underwriting years (notably 2014, 2016, 2018 and 2019) partially offset by releases on other years. The Managing Agent reports a net prior year release of $57.0m (after reinsurance), reflecting favourable run-off in most classes offset by adverse development in Specialty (primarily Contingency/COVID-19 related). Key causal factors cited include favourable and adverse claims development by class, COVID-19 pandemic impacts (contingency/event cancellation), the effect of reinsurance recoveries and ongoing inflationary uncertainty.
raw_causal_phrases: There has been a reassessment of the net provision for claims outstanding held at the previous year end.
The release in 2021 amounted to $57.0m (2020: $42.8m), attributable to the following classes of business:

There has been favourable run-off of prior year business for all classes, other than the Specialty class, which experienced adverse development of $26.1m (2020: favourable run-off of $4.6m), primarily due to the Contingency class.
Net technical provisions includes $49.0m (2020: $128.9m) relating to the COVID-19 pandemic arising primarily in the Contingency class of business.
data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are presented in the report's native currency (USD) and reported here as plain numbers in millions. The named 'release' of $57.0m quoted in the report is a net figure (after reinsurance) shown in the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note; because that note only reports net amounts, the aggregated prior year development above was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross figures) as a fallback. LOB mappings for 'Political Risk' and 'Political Violence and War' were approximated to available standard categories (mapped to 'Treaty') where no exact standard name existed; this mapping is approximate and noted in confidence scores. Field names containing 'gbp' are fixed by the output schema but amounts are in USD as per the report.
